task.title: Compile exact tool components without activation
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/623 by compiling prepared bytes against the exact inert no-import tool component ABI.
acceptance_criteria: Accept binary components implementing only synchronous invoke(string) returning result<string, string>.
Reject malformed bytes, core modules, imports, missing or extra exports, and incompatible signatures.
Preserve exact artifact IDs and caller input order with all-or-nothing typed failures.
Create no store or instance and call no guest export during compilation.

attempts.summary: Established RED coverage for the exact component compiler boundary.
attempts.diagnostic: No compilation API or artifact-specific component compilation error existed.
attempts.patch: Added tests requiring valid inert components and fail-closed handling of malformed, imported, structurally incompatible, and extra interface surface.

attempts.summary: Implemented narrowly featured inert Wasmtime compilation.
attempts.diagnostic: Structural Component Model validation can enforce the version 0.1.0 no-import world before any store, instance, adapter, or permission boundary exists.
attempts.patch: Added Wasmtime Component Model compilation, exact top-level import and export checks, owned compiled artifacts, and typed source-preserving errors.

attempts.summary: Kept compilation independent from activation and invocation.
attempts.diagnostic: Components containing trapping code proved that binary compilation and ABI inspection do not instantiate or run guest exports.
attempts.patch: Documented and tested the inert all-or-nothing compiler contract and deferred adapters, stores, resource policy, and registration.

outcome.summary: Vela now compiles prepared tools into owned inert components only when every artifact matches the exact no-import version 0.1.0 ABI.

verification.command: nix develop --command cargo test -p vela-extensions --test manifest compilation_ --locked
GitHub Rust quality gate https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/actions/runs/30207891738 and substantive exact-head CodeRabbit review at https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/pull/624

lessons: Compile and ABI validation can remain a completely inert boundary with no guest instance.
Rejecting all imports avoids creating an accidental ambient host capability contract.
Exact interface shape should reject both missing requirements and unsupported extra surface.
Artifact-specific typed errors preserve deterministic batch diagnostics without exposing a partial result.
